profile.headline: Full-Stack Software Developer
profile.summary:
Full-stack developer | Software Developer | Programmer Analyst with a Master's degree in Computer Applications and more than 8 years of experience 
mainly in developing web applications and enterprise solutions using various combinations of tools and technologies such as 
C#, Java, Javascript, TypeScript, PL/SQL, ASP.Net, React, HTML, CSS, MySQL, Oracle and others 
and following methodology like Waterfall and agile.

Along with applying coding skills, I've been playing the roles responsible for full software lifecycle development 
starting from requirement analysis, design, unit testing, integration testing, UAT, documentation, end-user training, deploying, and providing user support for applications.

Experience of working across several domains such as  Time-Attendance, Payroll, and HR, EPC(Engineering automation, Refinery Operations), eCommerce, Embedded Product Engineering 
makes me more flexible in understanding and offering solutions to project requirements.

Always looking for growth and improvements by providing my best possible inputs, be it for the organization that I work for, the community, or myself.

positions.title: Customer Service Specialist
positions.description:
- Successfully completion of training for handling customers  and operating company's software applications 
- Respond to customer inquiries via telephone
- Provide problem resolution in accordance with the organization's service standards
- Navigate through a computerized data entry system and other relevant applications to fetch/note customer's information
- Redirect the call to other relevant departments in case customer's need doesn't belong to your department
- Analyze customer service needs and offer them the company's latest product or services as per their needs
- Work in a fast-paced environment

positions.title: Software Programmer Analyst
positions.description:
Responsible for the engineering automation and Tech Support for brown-field projects of JERP and DTA   at Jamnagar, Gujarat, India
Projects: MoC Tracking System, Site Query Tracking System, Electrical Material Take Off, Civil Material Take Off, Performance Management System
Domains: HR management, engineering, construction, and refinery operations

- MoC Tracking System: Developed an application for tracking the progress of MoCs (Management of Change). All the involved engineering disciplines can update the progress and status of their MoCs and provide comments and constraints so that the Project Control department can take action accordingly. Prepared a report generating tool that can produce various data reports for engineering hours, resources, comments, MoC Status, Progress Status, constraints. 
- Developed a Site Query Tracking System which improves the visibility of the status of site queries, makes the communication among stakeholders clear, easy and trackable. Various reports can be generated like a yearly report, quarterly report, reports by site query type, reports by engineering disciplines
- Material Take Off applications for Electrical and Civil disciplines. Materials can be uploaded in Excel or CSV files. In the case of incorrect material code, it can be replaced. Various reports can be generated.
- PMS: Performance Management System is an application that can be administrated by the HR Team and accessed by all other employees during the time of performance assessment. This application makes the performance review process easy for Managers and HR Teams as there is a large number of employees in the company. Employees can enter their duties performed on various projects during the year. Managers assess the performance and provide their ratings on various aspects. HR Team can generate the Performance reports and based on that payrolls can be updated.
